rawFindings.title: In watcher.js, watchPatterns now only considers patterns with 'watched' true, but the argument passed is already filtered (patterns are strings), causing a runtime error
rawFindings.explanation: In the 'watchPatterns' function, the parameter 'patterns' is now expected to be an array of pattern objects having .pattern and .watched properties. However, in the call from 'exports.watch()', the argument passed is already an array of strings (patterns), not objects, leading to attempting to access 'patternObject.pattern' on a string, which causes an error.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change 'watchPatterns' to accept pattern strings as before or adjust the calling code to pass pattern objects instead of strings.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling watchPatterns with an array of strings causes a TypeError when iterating and trying to read .pattern or .watched properties of string.

rawFindings.title: In watcher.js, createIgnore now only ignores by excludes, removing prior logic rejecting files not matching watched patterns, potentially causing watched files to be ignored
rawFindings.explanation: The 'createIgnore' function was simplified to only exclude files matching exclude patterns, while previously it also ignored files that did not match any watched patterns. This change may cause chokidar to report events on files that are not matched by any watched pattern, potentially causing unexpected behavior in file list synchronization.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore prior logic of also ignoring files that don't match any watched pattern, or ensure fileList and other components can handle spurious events for non-watched files.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Files outside watched patterns but not in excludes may be reported and trigger unnecessary actions in fileList.

rawFindings.title: In watcher.js, watchPatterns now iterates over pattern objects but is called with array of strings, breaking watching logic
rawFindings.explanation: The call to watchPatterns in exports.watch() passes 'patterns' (strings), but watchPatterns now expects an array of pattern objects with .pattern and .watched properties, causing runtime errors or faulty watcher additions.
rawFindings.suggestion: Pass the original pattern objects to watchPatterns or revert watchPatterns to accept array of strings corresponding to watched patterns.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: watchPatterns throws TypeError due to missing properties or watches no paths since premature returns happen.
